node.title: Re^3: strawberry win10 no ARGV
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Have you tried running your second script as "perl script.pl arg1 arg2 ..." instead of "script.pl arg1 arg2 ..."? You might need to add the full path to the Perl binary, which you can normally get from [doc://$^X] (or [doc://Config]'s $Config{perlpath}, as documented in the first link). Also note my node [id://1180578|here] in regards to the potential issues with using qx//.
